limitations: Rendered tests run on Linux with a virtual Xbox controller; no Windows graphical session or physical Xbox was available.
37 Unity humanoid .anim clips and 176 FBX ranges were catalogued, not all integrated. Ten FBX cycles were converted to native non-contact locomotion.
Demo.zip, FOOTBALL_KINGDOM_BANANAMAN.zip, Animations.zip and Data.zip exceeded the 32 MiB transfer limit and were not read.
Native hybrid motion matching and physical layers are not Euphoria.
development_findings: Baseline probe reproduced kicks before the restart signal.
Keeping every taker stationary also prevented the native run-up; restriction is now specific to throw-ins.
Separately interpolated additive/source poses did not consistently reduce running noise alone; a contact-masked 18 ms tracking filter was added.
Initial diagnostic records interleaved across renderer/physics threads; each diagnostic is now emitted as one formatted record.
Fluency analysis retains the final contact evaluation at each tick rather than an intermediate evaluation.
Imported movement heights use offsets from the native pelvis bind; post-loop-correction support is recomputed.
